ai-design-studio.role: Product design, creative direction and AI-assisted development.
ai-design-studio.challenge: Move beyond a generated image to a composition a designer can revise and prepare for use.
ai-design-studio.decision: Keep the canvas central and separate generation from layer and element controls, so refinement stays in the same workspace.
ai-design-studio.delivery: A web design workspace combining brief input, formats, layers, elements and export controls.
ai-design-studio.evidence: The live studio is linked below. Interface reconstructions and feature illustrations are identified throughout the story.

content-studio.role: Product design, information architecture and editorial workflow automation.
content-studio.challenge: Bring regional news and video sources into a workspace that preserves the context behind each report.
content-studio.decision: Keep region, date and source selection visible, with news and video monitoring organised around distinct editorial tasks.
content-studio.delivery: A news and video workspace with regional navigation, search, filtering and original-source access.
content-studio.evidence: Actual News and Videos captures from 21 October 2026 appear below, alongside labelled interface reconstructions.

social-media-intelligence.role: Product design, analytics information architecture and reporting workflows.
social-media-intelligence.challenge: Make platform, account and reporting context understandable before asking people to interpret performance.
social-media-intelligence.decision: Keep filters explicit and distinguish checked account identities and available data from missing or unconnected metrics.
social-media-intelligence.delivery: An analytics workspace organised around account context, comparison, reporting periods and data availability.
social-media-intelligence.evidence: The linked workspace and illustrated interface studies show the workflow. Sample visuals do not represent measured campaign results.

content-tracker.role: Product design, content operations and cross-platform workflow design.
content-tracker.challenge: Connect a submitted creative to its published links across Facebook, Instagram and X.
content-tracker.decision: Treat the creative as the shared record, while keeping each platform’s link and verification state separate.
content-tracker.delivery: A content ledger with creative previews, platform records and a visible queue for saved, checking and unavailable links.
content-tracker.evidence: The product is linked below. Reconstructed screens use sample records to explain the workflow.

splitmate.role: Product design and AI-assisted implementation of a private expense-sharing workflow.
splitmate.challenge: Help two people understand shared expenses and balances without turning a simple agreement into a complex finance tool.
splitmate.decision: Lead with who owes whom, explain the split, and keep settlement records distinct from money transfers.
splitmate.delivery: A mobile-first expense ledger with split methods, a shared balance and privacy-aware joining.
splitmate.evidence: Source-informed screen reconstructions and an interactive split example explain the decisions. People and balances are fictional.

clip-studio.role: Product design, download workflow design and AI-assisted implementation.
clip-studio.challenge: Connect link input, output choices, job progress and short-clip editing in one understandable production workflow.
clip-studio.decision: Separate resolution from compatibility, and give queued, processing, completed and failed jobs distinct states.
clip-studio.delivery: A desktop-oriented media utility interface with output modes, job history and Quick Clip controls.
clip-studio.evidence: This story documents the supplied implementation. Interactive examples demonstrate the interface; live extraction and device saving require separate validation.
